name: Procedural Volumetric Cloud Rendering
definition: A real-time volumetric cloud rendering system implemented in Unity 2022.3, inspired by Horizon: Zero Dawn, using Perlin-Worley noise for density generation and raymarching for volume integration.
summary: Procedural Volumetric Cloud Rendering is a real-time technique that ray-marches spherical cloud layers using tileable 3D noise and specific cloud physics, distinguishing itself by generating density procedurally rather than via voxel grids or generic fog.
